decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE specifying the final PDF as the Heyzine upload artifact. Account ownership and upload responsibility remain attributes of the source Requirement.
Moving the Heyzine upload to the client's account does not change the required two-page spread behavior or even-page-count constraint.
The request to send the final PDF changes the upload workflow, not the existing digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The separate clause requiring only the supplied images and no additional text is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY, including removal of obsolete filler alternatives.
Client-controlled Heyzine uploading does not change the requirement for accurate final page references on the cover.
The platform, branding, and upload-workflow decision does not alter the November issue or inaugural-edition metadata.
The Heyzine account and upload-responsibility change does not alter the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number basis.
The upload-workflow decision has no necessary effect on advertisement clarity or rendering quality.
Heyzine white-label account ownership does not modify the magazine layout's polished Civic Lantern visual style requirement.
The platform and upload-workflow decision does not change the requirement to enhance low-quality publication images when necessary.
The completed magazine-template requirement remains unchanged by the client's decision to upload the final PDF through a white-label Heyzine account.
The Heyzine branding and upload decision does not affect author names, photographs, sources, or placement.
